name: grid_limit_mw

name: heatwave_c

name: seed
note: Random seed of all synthetic profiles

name: p_mw

name: e_mwh

note: Usable SOC window lower bound (of nameplate)

name: soc_max
note: Usable SOC window upper bound

name: eta_rt

name: availability

name: cal_fade

name: cycle_life
note: Equivalent full cycles to 80 % SOH

name: deg_cost_eur_mwh
note: Throughput degradation cost (DC block cost / cycle life)

name: response_ms
note: PCS full-power step response (grid-following); 20–50 ms grid-forming

name: fault_pu
note: PCS fault-current limit (per unit of rated current)

name: s_mva
note: PCS apparent power (Q for p.f. ≥ 0.95 at the connection point)

name: scenario
note: Price year: '2025', '2026' (Jan–Aug) or 'saturated' (0.5 × 2026, ASSUMED)

name: spot_mean

name: spot_daily_spread
note: Synthetic diurnal price amplitude (fraction of mean)

name: sek_per_eur
